mapper.select: select count(*) from basket_team where is_delete = 0 and audit_status in (0, 3)
select count(*) from basket_player_cert_application where is_delete = 0 and application_status in (1, 2)
select count(*) from basket_tournament_registration r inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = r.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 where r.is_delete = 0 and r.registration_status in (1, 2)
select count(*) from basket_tournament_open_registration r inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = r.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 where r.is_delete = 0 and r.registration_status in (1, 2)
select count(*) from basket_tournament_roster_change_request r inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = r.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 where r.is_delete = 0 and r.request_status = 0
select count(*) from basket_player_platform_change_request where is_delete = 0 and request_status = 0

select count(*) from basket_match_data_audit a inner join basket_match m on m.id = a.match_id and m.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = m.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 where a.is_delete = 0 and a.audit_status = 'PENDING'

select count(*) from basket_match_data_dispute d inner join basket_match m on m.id = d.match_id and m.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_tournament_season s on s.id = m.season_id and s.is_delete = 0 where d.is_delete = 0 and d.dispute_status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
